title: A Goblin's Escort
summary: Escort the goblins in order and confront the boss at the end of the route.
overview: Escort the goblins in order and confront the boss at the end of the route.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: Speak to Higglin and follow the mission dialogue stages in order.
Stay close to the currently moving goblin and clear enemies along its route.
Wait for each escort to arrive before trying the next conversation.
The final boss becomes hostile through dialogue, so regroup before speaking.

notes: Reviewed quest source; behavior, balance, spawns and completion have not been verified in a live instance.
This document applies to instance version 2.
